description: Search FDIC bank failures by date range. Returns bank name, location, CERT ID, failure date, acquiring institution, and fund type, reconciled against FDIC's published Failed Bank List with a `data_as_of` date and a `warning` field when FDIC's own search index is lagging.

end_date.description: End date filter — MM/DD/YYYY ("12/31/2023"), YYYY-MM-DD, or a bare year ("2023")

limit.description: Number of failure records to return (default 20)

start_date.description: Start date filter — MM/DD/YYYY ("01/01/2023"), YYYY-MM-DD, or a bare year ("2023")

name: fdic_failures
